# Vendored DSH UI components (tests only)

Unmodified copies of the DeepSeek Harness `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`
source files these tests render, taken from tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`
(`packages/client/ui-primitives/src`). The published package is built for the
DSH page module loader, so jsdom tests use the source instead.
